The '''''Valor''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

==History==
The ''Valor'' served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Val DeGoort]]. After an incident where the ''Valor'' collided with another star destroyer during a close-approach coordinated-action exercise, DeGoort and his ship were transferred to [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] as a "penal" assignment.<ref name="GSE51" />

As part of the [[Goroth task force]], the ''Valor'' was in permanent equatorial orbit around the strategically important [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="GSE" /> The second slot in the [[Goroth task force|task force]] was taken up by another ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer on rotation roster of two months.<ref name="GSE51" />

With the ship permanently assigned to Goroth, a large part of the ''Valor''{{'s}} [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] complement was assigned to the planetary [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]]. Twenty-four were stationed at [[Graith]], eight at [[A'Lenba]] and another eight scattered among other [[o'beki]]s.<ref name="GSE51" />
